## Purpose

Release gate for the active canonical numerical reference. The frozen Step 22
fixture remains a secondary historical comparator, not an analytical input.

```{r}
step22 <- targets::tar_read(step22_reference_validation)
canonical_reference <- targets::tar_read(canonical_reference_validation)
active <- targets::tar_read(active_downstream_release_validation)
migration <- targets::tar_read(phylogeny_migration_equivalence)
phylogeny <- targets::tar_read(phylogeny_reproduction_validation)
figures <- targets::tar_read(retained_figure_copy_audit)
release <- targets::tar_read(release_validation)
run_provenance <- targets::tar_read(canonical_run_provenance)
family <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  targets::tar_read(family_auc_data_equivalence),
  targets::tar_read(family_V_equivalence),
  targets::tar_read(family_model_equivalence),
  targets::tar_read(family_support_equivalence),
  targets::tar_read(family_random_equivalence),
  targets::tar_read(family_classification_equivalence),
  targets::tar_read(family_model_summary_equivalence)
)
models <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  targets::tar_read(mboth_526_refit_equivalence),
  targets::tar_read(mboth_variance_profile_equivalence),
  targets::tar_read(predictor_model_fit_equivalence),
  targets::tar_read(predictor_model_comparisons_equivalence),
  targets::tar_read(predictor_CR1_equivalence),
  targets::tar_read(heterogeneity_components_equivalence),
  targets::tar_read(heterogeneity_synthesis_equivalence)
)
knitr::kable(step22)
knitr::kable(canonical_reference)
knitr::kable(active)
knitr::kable(migration)
knitr::kable(phylogeny)
knitr::kable(family)
knitr::kable(models)
knitr::kable(figures)
knitr::kable(release)
knitr::kable(run_provenance)
```

## PASS/FAIL

All active numerical, structural, phylogenetic, migration, canonical-reference,
and retained-copy checks must pass. The Step 22 comparison is reported for
historical transparency and is not an active scientific-input gate. Regenerated
figure pixels and file hashes are intentionally outside the numerical
regression contract.
